description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book the Lovely Home: * Gorgeous Interior with High-end Finishes* Large Screened in Sunroom with Seating* 4 Bikes Available* Dog Friendly ($250 Additional Fee)* Less than a mile from the Beach - Gulf View Heights Access* Community Pool, Grills, Covered Picnic Area, and Playground* Quiet Neighborhood, Fishable Lake, and Nature Trails* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is not available to adults under age 25. No Exceptions. *Welcome to Hallie's House in the serene Forest Lakes neighborhood of Blue Mountain! This charming 3-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom retreat offers a peaceful escape from everyday life. As you drive through the gated entrance and along the tree-lined cobblestone streets, you’ll immediately feel the calming atmosphere. On the first floor, you'll find a spacious master king bedroom. Upstairs, there are two guest rooms: one with a cozy queen bed and another featuring two sets of twin-over-queen bunk beds, accommodating up to 10 guests comfortably. The well-equipped kitchen is perfect for preparing everything from your morning coffee to a gourmet dinner. Enjoy your coffee on the porch swing, soaking in the natural beauty that surrounds you. Plus, with 4 bikes included, you can easily explore nearby beaches and attractions, including Gulf Place Town Center. Don’t miss the chance to create unforgettable memories at Hallie’s House! Book your stay today!Forest Lakes neighborhood has an idyllic setting overlooking a peaceful lake with thousands of acres of state forest bordering the community. Completely secluded and quiet, it's hard to believe Highway 30A is just down the road and offers quick access to all the amenities you could desire in this South Santa Rosa Beach location. The recently renovated community pools offer for a relaxing dip after a long day at the beach. Make memories on the fishable lake, that's catch and release, and there's also a lovely, covered picnic area with grills, as well as a playground for the kiddos. Blue Mountain Beach is just to the east, and the shops, entertainment, and dining venues of Gulf Place Town Center are a short drive to the west. Incredible white sand beaches are a few minutes down the road.Hallie's House is Dog-Friendly and welcomes up to two dogs, each with a weight limit of 100 pounds. If you're traveling with a pet, please contact our reservations team within 24 hours of booking. Guests will be responsible for a non-refundable pet fee.*Please note this home is located within an HOA community. Guests are required to follow all HOA rules and regulations, carefully review the rental agreement in full, and observe all posted signage throughout the home to ensure a smooth and enjoyable stay**Two parking spots are available in the driveway, and no street parking is allowed. *Bed Setup:1st Floor:Master Bedroom: King Bed2nd Floor:Guest Bedroom: Queen BedGuest Bedroom: Two Twin-over-Queen BunkbedsArea Attractions:This is a fantastic location with Gulf Place Town Center only 1.5 miles to the West and Watercolor, Grayton Beach, Seaside, Seacrest, and Rosemary Beach just minutes away to the East. Biking is a great activity to enjoy as the scenic bike path meanders along 30A. Bike over to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery for some homemade scoops that will have your taste buds coming back! You'll have an array of dining options to choose from! 30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar white sand and emerald green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17-mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous, there are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here.The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
